translations.web: Having regard for honorable things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.
translations.bsb: For we are taking great care to do what is right, not only in the eyes of the Lord, but also in the eyes of men.
translations.kjv: Providing for honest things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.
translations.asv: for we take thought for things honorable, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.
